# The machine tier against the chroot rung (experiment 422, 2026-11-11). The
# guest has a kernel of its own: its /proc, /dev and /sys are the guest's,
# PID 1 is podvm's init in the guest, and the payload is root of the guest.
# The chroot rung mounts no /proc and no /dev in the image. Each target is
# named; no line takes a whole section, so a host path (host-store) stays
